title: Multiple instantsearch instances and URL Syncing
body:
I have a question regarding the multiple instantsearch instances on the same page and URL syncing.

We use one instance for "global" search and we also have "category" search that will search indices only by the current category.
The problem is that URL syncing is working only for one of the search instances, but we want this to work for both of them.

Is something like that possible?
